input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text, /moves/bishop_c8.text, or /moves/bishop_f8.text, the pieces that have already gone off plan, must be signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen agents' keys in /team/pieces/, including the moving piece itself.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_b8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_f8.id)] false))
